policy: Only public repository reports and synthetic replacements; no private histories, credentials, names, paths or paid model traffic.

cases.assertion: Concrete questions and exact sender/recipient identity reach a clean native peer; the actual reply is visible in both original chats.
Notify creates a visible message without starting a recipient model or demanding a reply.
Native skill and approval notices coexist with a real first human request; unknown sources and native vetoes stay rejected.
An expert joins the same work with exact material readers and shared budget, without private parent history or memory.
Real group input returns through the originating Bot; duplicate operations, stale generations, cancellation and lost replies cannot replay execution.
Browser opens both Bot chats, expands actual message cards and verifies real question/reply content with exact identities.
Each new product path has a real isolated Host receipt and actual Browser interaction from the same frozen package.
